name: word-rush-arena
description: Gerçek zamanlı Türkçe kelime düellosu — web, PWA ve Capacitor ile Android/iOS.

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
